camera_manifest: cameras.json contains every training and validation pose; identical in all conditions
test_denoiser: OpenImageDenoise 2.5.1, linear color/albedo/normal passes; same evaluator for all conditions
initialization_mesh: Neutral TSDF observations with quadric decimation target of 300000 faces; the algorithm may retain more faces, so actual counts are recorded. No photo atlas or surface completion. Coverage losses are diagnostic limitations of provisional evidence. Fixed for all tool conditions before formal trials.
input_prompt: 根据提供的多视角图像和相机信息，在 Blender 中重建场景。物体应可独立编辑，尽量匹配真实几何、布局、材质和外观，保存建模源码和场景工程。
repair_prompt: 检查当前场景与参考图像，修正发现的问题并提交新版本。
geometry_reference: Independent withheld three-view SIFT triangulation; sparse pseudo-reference, not scan ground truth.
isolation: Fresh model thread and per-run CODEX_HOME. Workspace-write sandbox; experiment access restrictions are task instructions, not a read-isolation security boundary.
initialization_cost: Fresh training-only DA3/TSDF preprocessing; reuse one frozen cache across conditions on the same scene; record elapsed time and hashes separately.
early_acceptance: Complete the fixed M0/R1/M1/R2/M2 schedule even if a reviewer accepts; no third reviewer. Preserve failures without replacing them with extra modeling passes.
test_access: Private evaluation inputs are excluded from agent task packets and tool containers. Agents must not inspect experiment siblings, prior reconstructions, or source dataset directories.

limitations: One repetition per scene/condition; not variance-controlled.
First three scenes have prior development use. Ten scenes are a curated DL3DV subset, not a random sample.
Different hardware/tool environments must be recorded; wall time is not comparable without hardware matching.
submission: Modeler saves candidate, edit targets and code. The two repair phases have no hard time limit; the initial modeling limit is 3600 seconds. Controller binds immutable input lineage and performs the final build for every condition. Record actual time and token usage for every attempt and continuation.
single_agent_feedback: Original observations, prior scene and short revision prompt only. No independent planner, inventory checklist or external review evidence.
submission_checks: Basic engineering validity plus explicit appearance-mode fields. Texture provenance and shadow separation require visual/source inspection.
reasoning_note: One model family per experiment root; planner, modeler and reviewer all use that same model at xhigh. No effort ablations.
